subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this MemoryRerankProvider public SDK API, memoryRerankProviders manifest gate, exclusive single-slot model, and builtin-only v1 scope?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but the decision creates a public plugin contract and chooses a product boundary that automation should not lock in without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve This Seam After Rebase
options.body: Accept the vendor-neutral pre-MMR SDK seam, require a conflict-safe rebase that preserves current abort handling, and land after exact-head validation.

options.title: Request API Shape Changes
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a different manifest gate, keyed registry, QMD policy, or SDK shape before merge.

options.title: Defer Or Close Behind Another Boundary
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the broader external-reranker plugin/config direction or the supplement-candidate path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve This Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the vendor-neutral pre-MMR SDK seam, require a conflict-safe rebase that preserves current abort handling, and land after exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily a public plugin SDK and manifest-contract direction decision, and recent history ties steipete to that boundary.
